headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest revenue and profit pressure.
summary: Overall revenue growth in the sector slowed, averaging around 10% YoY. AI services contributed to profit jumps at HCLTech and Coforge, but Infosys trimmed its FY guidance to 1‑2% growth. Margin expansion was limited, with operating margins ranging from 14.8% to 24%. Headcount attrition stayed high, above 12% at most large players.

themes.title: AI as profit catalyst
themes.detail: Companies reporting AI revenue growth (HCLTech, Infosys, TCS) saw double‑digit profit increases.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY growth, while Infosys and Wipro grew under 10% YoY.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed flat or fell for several firms despite higher profits.
